title: Chapter 240 Fear
content:
Chapter 240 Fear

Some of these coalition forces now are nothing more than enthusiasm, and the fiefs and titles promised by their superiors, and the temptation to get promoted and get rich is driving them.

Therefore, the Qin army has strict defenses, and their weapons are relatively neat, at least much more than these coalition forces, and some simple fortifications have also been arranged.

With these defenses in place, it would be quite difficult for these coalition forces with crude weapons and severe physical exertion to break through this line of defense at once.

But all these difficulties are not a problem. For the coalition forces who already have ideal support in their hearts and have the belief in fighting, all difficulties are paper tigers. As long as they want to do it, there is nothing they cannot do.

Isn't it just that there is no engineering equipment? What are you afraid of! We have full of passion and a spirit that is not afraid of death.

Isn't it just crude weapons? What's the matter! We have a firm will and the belief that we dare to fight and kill.

Isn't it just physical exertion? This is nothing! As long as he can kill these Qin soldiers and earn credits, he might be able to confer titles and marquises.

In the future, once and for all, you can stay in your own fief and enjoy the scenery of your next life. How can you care about such a little physical exertion now?

Physical exhaustion cannot stop their spiritual excitement and their yearning for the future.

So after overcoming all kinds of difficulties in the heart, the coalition forces directly launched a round of attacks, facing the waves of arrows shot by the Qin army, and rushed forward without fear of death.

Even people like Xiaoyaozi who were watching the battle from a distance outside the battlefield could still feel the morale of the coalition forces and the soaring murderous aura.

Although those coalition forces directly emptied a small area of the battlefield under the bursts of arrows from the Qin army, the coalition forces, which made the offensive extremely coherent, inevitably experienced a short period of stop and confusion.

However, these problems were quickly made up for by the equally fearless coalition forces behind. The soldiers seemed to be unable to see the casualties in front of them, so they just made up for it and continued to fill the gaps in the front line.

These fighting wills, this fighting spirit, not to mention those Qin troops who faced the coalition forces directly, were on the front, directly feeling the killing and madness of those coalition forces.

Even people like Xiaoyaozi, who hid far away on a hill more than ten miles away from the battlefield and were secretly observing the situation on the battlefield, felt a chill from the bottom of their hearts, and even many people's backs were covered with cold sweat , the body trembled a little.

It's not that these people's psychological quality is not good. After all, they are all strong men of the generation.

How could a master of the rivers and lakes like them have poor psychological quality? To get to their stage, in addition to countless killings, the necessary psychological cultivation is also indispensable.

What really frightened them was the will to fight of these coalition forces, not the carnage they caused.

The disregard for life and death of these coalition forces has reached an extreme point, it can almost be said that they don't care about their own lives, and all they want is victory in the battle.

So, what is it that can support them like this? People like Xiaoyaozi asked themselves, tortured themselves constantly, but couldn't find an answer after all.

Even though they are well-educated, well-versed in ancient and modern times, Ozawa, all kinds of anecdotes and secrets, historical books and scriptures, they have never found such a situation, and there is not even the slightest example in history that can be cited for them to use as a reference.

However, it was precisely this that made them even more fearful.

Because, these coalition forces are now treating Qin with such excitement. However, who would have imagined what would happen if these allied forces treated themselves, their school of thought, and their own country afterward!

Xiaoyaozi and the others thought about it, but they sighed helplessly in their hearts. After thinking about it, they knew that if the coalition forces headed by Yu Guo had this kind of combat power, let alone Qin, I am afraid that they would not be able to sweep the whole world. question.

Amidst the amazement and fear of those people who are free and easy, the situation on the opposite battlefield has undergone tremendous changes.

On the battlefield, as the entire Qin army collapsed and fled, the huge battlefield, with dozens of miles around, was the only place where the deputy general was located, and some of his large-scale Qin army were barely resisting.

In other places, there is indeed no more Qin army. Those brave soldiers of Qin who stayed to resist the coalition forces were either killed by the coalition forces who came to surround them, or they were wrapped up by those defeated soldiers and fled together. .

So in the entire battlefield, there are only a few thousand coalition troops left to clean up. Let's see if those Qin soldiers are hiding among the corpses on the ground, acting as dead bodies, trying to get away with confusion. If there are any, give them a knife or two , which will be the responsibility of these coalition forces.

Farther away on the battlefield, there are still nearly 10,000 coalition troops chasing and killing those Qin troops fleeing in the direction, chasing after them.

Now is a good time. The morale and resistance of those Qin troops have been completely defeated. It was just when they were in a panic and couldn't find their way. Their hearts were confused and their minds were shrouded in fear. Do not know at all!

Their only belief is probably to escape, escape from this battlefield, escape from this vortex of death, the farther the better.

Therefore, in such a state and thinking, the entire Qin army did not dare to resist at all, and could only flee aimlessly and run around.

So how could the coalition forces miss this great opportunity? Don't take advantage of the panic and fear of these Qin troops to kill some of them, reduce the number of those Qin troops, and weaken the strength of the Qin army.

Is it still waiting for these Qin troops to flee back to the camp, after a period of recuperation and recovery of morale, and then come to a frontal confrontation with these Qin troops who have recovered again?

Thinking about the fierce confrontation with the Qin army in the past few days, the number of casualties, and the countless Zepao buried in this small place, these coalition forces felt a chill, and naturally they ran faster and chased more and more. Be diligent.

And in the center of the battlefield, where all the whirlpools are now gathered, the 10,000 Qin army that the deputy general is in is not very comfortable.

After all, there is more than three times the difference in numbers between the two sides. In the case of one against three, they are all troops with a cooperative concept, so there is naturally a huge disparity in strength.

Even if Qin State had some advantages in equipment and limited geographical advantage, it can be said that there was a little bit, but it still couldn't stop the attack of the coalition forces.
